review::.::holistic::cross_module_archit.summary: High responsibility density in orchestration files

evidence: Both files are ~600 LOC and manage assets, search, PWA, social cards, and post processing in a single flow.
They act as a hub for many unrelated build concerns.
detail.suggestion: Decompose the build orchestration into smaller, concern-specific steps or pipelines to reduce the size and coupling of the main run package files.

review::.::holistic::convention_outlier:.summary: Identical MemSink mock duplicated in two packages

evidence: The MemSink implementation is exactly the same in both files, including all methods (WriteFile, WriteStream, etc.).
This creates multiple sources of truth for the same mock logic.
detail.suggestion: Unify the MemSink mock in a single location, preferably in the builder/testutil package, and have other tests import it from there.

review::.::holistic::error_consistency::.summary: Silent I/O error swallowing in PWA icon generation

evidence: Several instances of _ = on os.WriteFile and b.Sink.WriteFile calls (lines 80, 82, 86, 89, 97, 102).
This masks potential permission issues or disk full errors in the PWA generation phase.
detail.suggestion: Handle or return errors from all I/O operations. In non-critical caching steps, log the error instead of swallowing it.

review::.::holistic::error_consistency::.summary: Inconsistent error propagation in site-wide generators

evidence: In renderSiteMetadata (lines 510-582), the Knowledge Graph generator logs errors but continues (line 559), whereas Sitemap and RSS generators return the error and halt the build.
This leads to inconsistent build failure behavior depending on which generator fails.
detail.suggestion: Standardize the error propagation strategy for all site-wide generators. Either all should halt the build on failure, or all should log and continue if the data is considered optional.

review::.::holistic::abstraction_fitness.summary: PostService.Process is a 300+ line monster function with too many responsibilities

evidence: Process method (line 64-392) handles parsing, caching, math rendering, social cards, and navigation aggregation.
detail.suggestion: Decompose PostService into smaller, specialized services (e.g., MarkdownParser, CacheManager, NavigationAggregator) and orchestrate them in a cleaner pipeline.

review::.::holistic::abstraction_fitness.summary: Config struct is a monolithic bag of unrelated parameters

evidence: Config struct (line 67-103) contains CLI flags, directory paths, feature toggles, and theme metadata.
detail.suggestion: Split Config into more focused domain configurations (e.g., BuildOptions, ThemeConfig, FeatureToggles) to clarify boundaries.

review::.::holistic::dependency_health::.summary: Redundant image and font libraries can be unified

evidence: Imaging, gg, freetype, and x/image all pulled in for separate but related image processing tasks.
detail.suggestion: Consolidate on a single set of image processing tools (e.g., standard x/image plus one wrapper) to reduce dependency sprawl.

review::.::holistic::dependency_health::.summary: Multiple brotli/compression providers can be consolidated

evidence: andybalholm/brotli and klauspost/compress are both present. klauspost/compress already includes a performant brotli implementation.
detail.suggestion: Unify on klauspost/compress for both zstd and brotli to remove the separate andybalholm/brotli dependency.

review::.::holistic::low_level_elegance:.summary: PerformSearch in builder/search/engine.go is a 600+ line monster function

evidence: PerformSearch (line 44-326) handles query parsing, multiple match strategies, scoring, and boosting in a single large body.
detail.suggestion: Extract query parsing, term matching strategies (exact, fuzzy, prefix), and boosting logic into separate, focused private methods.

review::.::holistic::low_level_elegance:.summary: High complexity and lack of decomposition in image processing

evidence: processImageVFS (line 414-592) is 180 lines long and handles everything from cache checks and dekinking to resizing and encoding.
detail.suggestion: Break down the image processing pipeline into discrete steps: CacheCheck, Decoder, Transformer, and Encoder.

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: Leaky integration seam in PostService via MetadataReadyFunc callback

evidence: PostService (line 33) exposes SetMetadataCallback to notify site-wide generators (sitemap, RSS, etc.) when metadata is ready.
detail.suggestion: Introduce an event-driven system or a cleaner orchestration layer to decouple post processing from site-wide generation tasks.

review::.::holistic::mid_level_elegance:.summary: Scattered initialization and wiring across the build loop

evidence: refreshBuildSession (line 23) manually injects sinks/transactions into multiple services on every build pass.
detail.suggestion: Centralize service initialization and wiring in a dedicated setup phase or use a simple DI container to avoid manual setters.

evidence: chaos_test.go (line 21-56) requires extensive manual service and mock setup for a single test case.
detail.suggestion: Introduce test factories or helpers to simplify common service and mock wiring in complex test cases.

review::.::holistic::test_strategy::sing.summary: High coupling to a single test scaffold structure

evidence: ScaffoldTestSite is used as the basis for most integration and unit tests, potentially missing edge cases in different site layouts.
detail.suggestion: Parameterize the scaffold tool to allow generating varied site structures (e.g., deeply nested content, missing themes, invalid configs).

evidence: func CopyDirVFS(ctx context.Context, srcFs afero.Fs, sink ArtifactSink, srcDir, dstDir string, compress bool, excludeExts []string, onWrite func(string), cacheDir string, imageWorkers int, webpQuality int, m interface { ... }) error
detail.suggestion: Introduce a CopyOptions struct to group related parameters (compress, excludeExts, onWrite, cacheDir, imageWorkers, webpQuality, m).

review::.::holistic::api_surface_coheren.summary: PostResult struct is deconstructed into multi-valued returns in wrappers

evidence: func (b *Builder) processPosts(...) ([]models.PostMetadata, []models.PostMetadata, map[string][]models.PostMetadata, []models.IndexedPost, bool, bool, error)
detail.suggestion: Keep the PostResult struct as the return type for all wrappers and callbacks to simplify signatures and improve type safety.

review::.::holistic::ai_generated_debt::.summary: Some comments merely restate the code following them

evidence: // Commit complete
// Join and get absolute path
detail.suggestion: Remove comments that add no insight beyond what the code itself clearly communicates.

review::.::holistic::package_organizatio.summary: builder/utils/ is an overloaded dumping ground (29 files)

evidence: directory_profiles shows 29 files with varied responsibilities
detail.suggestion: Split builder/utils into specialized packages: builder/fs (I/O, copy, walk, flock), builder/concurrency (worker pools, scheduler, pools), and builder/tx (transaction and sink logic).

review::.::holistic::package_organizatio.summary: Post-processing logic is fragmented across multiple service files

evidence: 6 post_*.go files in builder/services/
detail.suggestion: Move post-processing logic to a dedicated builder/services/post/ sub-package to improve service layer cohesion.

review::.::holistic::initialization_coup.summary: TestingMode is set via import-time side effect based on os.Args

evidence: func init() { if strings.HasSuffix(os.Args[0], ".test") { utils.TestingMode = true } }
detail.suggestion: Move TestingMode to a configuration struct or an explicit setup function called by the main entry points and test helpers.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::o.summary: Renderer struct mixes template management with asset and error tracking

evidence: Renderer struct contains Layout, Assets, RenderedSet, and renderErrors fields
detail.suggestion: Extract asset management into an AssetRegistry and error tracking into a BuildTracker to keep the Renderer focused on its primary job of template execution.

review::.::holistic::design_coherence::w.summary: Core functions use excessively wide parameter lists instead of config objects

evidence: CopyDirVFS has 12 parameters; PostService.Process return has 7 values
detail.suggestion: Introduce Options and Result structs for these boundaries to improve readability and allow for future extension without breaking signatures.

review::.::holistic::contract_coherence:.summary: GetErrors is destructive and should be renamed

evidence: func (r *Renderer) GetErrors() []error { ... r.renderErrors = nil // Clear after retrieval }
detail.suggestion: Rename GetErrors to PopErrors or ConsumeErrors to signal that it mutates the state by clearing the collected errors.
